items.text:
# The one rules file discovery MUST find in this tree.
#
# It sits two directories below the journal — the `import/YYYY/` layout
# `MAX_RULES_DEPTH` exists to allow — and it is named `*.csv.rules`, so its
# label is `bank` rather than `bank.csv`.
#
# It is ALSO the document `fixtures/rules/golden/rules-doc.json` is taken over,
# so it deliberately carries one of each shape that wire has to describe: the
# top-level settings a preferences panel renders, an editable one-matcher block,
# an editable multi-matcher OR list, an editable AND-group, and one advanced
# construct that must stay `opaque`. Changing it changes that golden —
# regenerate with `just snapshot-rules-wire` and review the diff.

items.label: if,account2,comment
items.text:
# A conditional TABLE. hledger reads each row positionally against the header,
# so an edit to the header would silently re-point every row — which is why
# Ledgeline never offers one for editing. This is the `opaque` item the golden
# exercises (OpaqueReason::IfTable); its extent runs to EOF here, and would be
# terminated by a blank line anywhere else.
if,account2,comment
ATM WITHDRAWAL,assets:cash,cash out
